privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires modeling the calcination of CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2. For 1000 kg of Limestone (input) and 560 kg of Quicklime (output), the mass balance requires exactly 440 kg of Carbon Dioxide (1000 - 560 = 440). The CO2 must be an elementary flow to air. A tolerance of 5% (418-462 kg) is acceptable, but 440 is the exact stoichiometric value.
